1.  **Quote at most 125 per unit**
2.  **Delivers within 9 days**
3.  **Rated at least 6 out of 10**

*   **Quinmere Cooperative**: Quote 100 (≤125), Delivery 8 days (≤9), Rating 10 (≥6). **Pass**.
*   **Isthurst Traders**: Quote 110 (≤125), Delivery 12 days (>9), Rating 5 (<6). **Fail** (delivery time and rating).
*   **Zelwick Cooperative**: Quote 135 (>125), Delivery 9 days (≤9), Rating 10 (≥6). **Fail** (quote).
*   **Istbury Cooperative**: Quote 75 (≤125), Delivery 16 days (>9), Rating 1 (<6). **Fail** (delivery time and rating).
*   **Harmore Cooperative**: Quote 185 (>125), Delivery 9 days (≤9), Rating 2 (<6). **Fail** (quote and rating).
*   **Jormore Traders**: Quote 105 (≤125), Delivery 20 days (>9), Rating 5 (<6). **Fail** (delivery time and rating).

Only Quinmere Cooperative meets all criteria.
